fields.label: COP31 Country Platform & Flagship Initiative Alignment
fields.value: Aligns directly with International Finance Corporation (IFC)'s COP31 Antalya role (Founding private-sector partner of Türkiye Industrial Decarbonization Investment Platform (TIDIP) targeting $6B by 2030) and 2026 commitment (Co-anchoring $6B TIDIP mobilization for steel, aluminum, cement & fertilizer decarbonization plus private-sector climate debt/equity). Anatolia Green Electric-Arc Steel & 120 MW Solar + BESS Decarbonization Project deploys Industrial Decarbonization in Türkiye, fitting priority sectors (Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Energy Storage) via Senior Debt. Grounded in policy references [inv_ifc::field_guide_03_cop31_platform_alignment], [inv_ifc::mandate_cop31].

fields.label: Quantified Climate Impact (tCO2e/year Avoided &/or Adaptation Beneficiaries)
fields.value: Quantified Climate Impact: 185,000 tCO2e/year avoided; 1,200 direct adaptation beneficiaries. Cuts steelmaking Scope 1 and Scope 2 carbon intensity by 62% (185,000 tCO2e/year avoided), directly supporting Türkiye's 2035 NDC and TIDIP industrial decarbonization targets. Directly mitigates EU CBAM carbon border liability for Turkish/regional exports. Projected commercial IRR: 15.8%. Grounded in policy references [inv_ifc::field_guide_07_ghg_and_adaptation_impact], [inv_ifc::compliance_esg].
